name: Is it better to repair a ceiling stain leak or replace the entire roof?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair a ceiling stain leak or replace the entire roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repairing a leak that caused a ceiling stain or replacing the entire roof depends on several factors, including the age of your roof, the extent of the damage, and its overall condition. If your roof is relatively new and the damage is localized, a repair is often sufficient. However, if your roof is older, has multiple areas of wear, or has experienced significant storm damage common in our DFW service area, a full replacement might be more cost-effective long-term. Our inspection report will detail the best course of action for your specific situation.
